description: Agent Mining Records: submit mining claim records, the claim-staking record for mineral land, with the mine record and the maintenance and assessment entries they answer to: the reading moment; each mine the mine record identifies with its id, reference, name and the moment the mine record relies on its claims; each claim with its id, reference, claim name, claim type (lode or placer), claimant, location, the mine it is held for and the moments it was located and lapses; each maintenance or assessment entry with its id, reference, the claim, the kind, the moment recorded and the moment the next entry is due. The signed report gives the claims and the records behind them, each claim against a mine the mine record identifies, each maintenance or assessment entry due against a later entry for its claim, each claim’s lapse date against the date its mine record relies on it, and each claim entry for its name, type, claimant and location, and counts them, and names divergent mining claim records: a claim recorded with no mine record behind it, a maintenance or assessment entry due with no later entry, a claim already lapsed at the date the mine record relies on it, and a claim entry missing the claim name, the claim type, the claimant or the location; then a maintenance entry naming a claim the record does not hold and one dated before its claim was located, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No claim entries, or no mine record beside claims, leaves those points unverified. Claims, mines and entries match by letters and digits, so SB-01 and SB 01 are one claim, dates by the day, a claim is current through the day it lapses, and an entry due after the reading moment waits. This reads claims staked on mineral land and the mineral tenure they carry; insurance claims stay with the Agent Claims family. Verdict mining_claim_record_divergent, mining_claim_record_partial, mining_claim_record_unverified or mining_claim_record_consistent. POST /api/mining-claim-record-check. Reads the mining records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads the records as supplied only: it operates no mine, contacts no regulator, land office or other operator and issues no permit, claim or certification, which stay with the mine operator, the land office and the regulators, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Mining Records reads mineral extraction records (hard-rock, coal, aggregate and quarry operations), not cryptocurrency mining and not data mining; the Agent Datasets family reads data sets. It reads a mine operator’s own records: mine records with operator licensing and certification entries, mining claim records for mineral land, mine permit records as issued, mine inspection records with citations and abatements, mine safety records with the blasting log, mining production records by period, the mine’s own tailings facility records and reclamation records with their bond entries, each against the permit, claim, production, certification, schedule, corrective action, shipment, capacity, closure and bond records it answers to. The family’s ground is the mine’s paper trail: what the mine record claims, whether the claims, permits and inspections hold up, what the safety and production records support, and whether the tailings and reclamation records line up; it reads by record holder and subject: the Agent Agriculture Records family reads a farm’s production and land records, the Agent Waste and Recycling Records family reads manifested waste and disposal records, wever_water-discharge-record-check reads mine effluent monitoring, and the Agent Claims family reads insurance claims, while this family reads the mine’s own records and reads none of those. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-mining-records-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-mining-records/.

claims.description: Each claim the mining claim record holds.

lapses_at.description: When the claim lapses, such as 2026-03-02.

located_at.description: When the claim was located, such as 2026-03-02.

mine.description: The mine the claim is held for reference.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

kind.description: The entry kind, such as maintenance fee or assessment work.

next_due_at.description: When the next entry is due, such as 2026-03-02.

mines.description: Each mine the mine record identifies.

relies_at.description: When the mine record relies on its claims, such as 2026-03-02.
